claim: Both enabled and disabled KMS keys count toward the KMS key limit of an account in a Region, so AWS recommends deleting disabled keys you no longer use; you may request a limit increase through the AWS Support Center.

evidence.quote: As both enabled and disabled KMS keys count towards the limit, we recommend deleting disabled keys that you no longer use.
You can create up to 100,000 KMS keys per account per Region.
You may request a limit increase for KMS keys by visiting the AWS Support Center.
